t: Forge Steel 450mm (17.7") bolt cutters offer robust cutting performance for various challenging materials. The durable tool is essential for professionals needing to cut steel, wire, chains, and bolts on construction sites or in workshops. Equipped with hardened carbon steel jaws, the cutters deliver reliable strength and durability, and are capable of cutting through steel up to 8mm thick. The flush cut head ensures precise results, while the plastic comfort grip handles offer improved control and reduced hand fatigue during extended use. The efficient metal cutting tool is ideal for any trade professional's kit.
